## Third incident (fixable-angular-caribou, d4c2-b67e-ab99-4410) — SAME root cause, different symptom

Reported while this fix was in review: caribou's close failed twice with "Evidence collection
reached its search boundary" on criteria whose evidence demonstrably exists on `main`. After an
evidence-anchor comment citing exact file:line locations was added, the RETRY GOT WORSE (2 unmet
-> 3 unmet). Plan review passed; only the completion verifier starved.

That "worse after adding evidence" shape is explained by root cause 1, not by a separate defect.
Measured directly against the tree the pre-fix close gate pinned
(`refs/heads/tickets` = 8b8d776f, the code repo's stale mirror):

    git ls-tree 8b8d776f d4c2-b67e-ab99-4410/  -> 3 events, 0 COMMENT events
    ls .tickets-tracker/d4c2-b67e-ab99-4410/   -> 13 COMMENT events

The verifier could not see ANY comment on that ticket, so the evidence anchors were invisible to
the run they were written for. Adding them could not help, and the retry simply re-explored a
stale, anchor-less ticket. Post-fix the same read returns all 13 comments including the anchors.

This is the second independent ticket (with wailsome-unsure-asianlion) whose close was blocked by
the stale pin, and the first where the staleness masqueraded as budget starvation rather than as
"no such comment exists". Whether caribou ALSO needs a step-budget change is a separate question,
now testable for the first time against a verifier that can actually see its evidence anchors.
